howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 04:00 AM PDT 20 August 2026 Today Tonight and Friday. Wind light increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 knots near noon then diminishing to light this evening. Wind becoming northerly outflow 5 to 10 near midnight then increasing to southerly inflow 10 to 20 Friday afternoon.
